newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco shares fall after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Toco shares fall after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Toco Holdings Ltd fell over 10 percent soon after the start of trade on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Friday following an earlier profit warning from the company.
By 0746 GMT shares in the industrial group had slid 10 percent to 85 cents after 16,000 units had changed hands.
"(The move down) is on the earnings notice in the newspaper this morning," one dealer said.

Toco said on Friday that total earnings attributable to ordinary shareholders for the year ended March 31, 1997 will be less favourable than anticipated at the time of the publication of the interim results.
The results will be published around May 30.
The warning follows an announcement last month that Toco was reshuffling its top management after its two joint managing directors resigned.
Toco shares have been falling steadily since November last year when they touched a high of 380 cents.
